earlier_primary_batch1_decision: Retained unchanged; this policy applies only to the two new neighbors.

primary.requires: canonical kept=True: >=1 primary improvement, no significant primary regression, complete matching samples and all correctness gates
primary.samples: six unchanged prompts, five serial repetitions each, per image

selection.eligibility: primary canonical keep AND every supplemental bound/correctness check
selection.final_revalidation: selected exact image requires a fresh 30-request serial run and every correctness gate before delivery
selection.if_both_eligible: largest geometric mean of canonical TTFT and FTGR point speedups; exact tie prefers batch8
selection.if_none_eligible: canonical baseline batch16 for the mixed-workload selection; earlier batch1 serial keep is still retained as a separate result
selection.multiplicity_limit: two fixed neighbors selected after observed batch1 tradeoff; exploratory selection, not independent confirmatory evidence

supplemental.method: same frozen six prompts; two synchronized six-request bursts per image; two separate 2086-input-token long requests per image
supplemental.missing_partial_invalid_or_mismatched_ev: ineligible, preserve evidence; do not impute success
supplemental.statistical_limit: Two bursts and two long requests are descriptive checks, not significance, power, or general workload claims.
